runtimeLoadingPreparation.requiredUserAction: Save current work and quit ChatGPT normally. Keep it quit until the guarded runtime operation finishes.
runtimeLoadingPreparation.executionBoundary: Activation refuses a running host, changed source/host/gateway/tunnel identity or active gateway tasks. Only the bound idle old gateway is signaled, after user quit. Canonical backend preparation retains the existing private capability, then canonical prepare-only and activate run. The tunnel daemon stays running. UI and actual dot write acceptance remain pending.
runtimeLoadingPreparation.userRequiredAction: Quit ChatGPT normally; the detached task observes that exact host lifetime ending, rechecks idle state, loads canonical runtime and reopens the client. Resume verification after reopening.
runtimeLoadingPreparation.firstWaiterFailure: A task-owned helper hit a local variable shadowing error before arming; it exited without any signal or write operation. Corrected and the replacement waiter is verified armed.
runtimeLoadingPreparation.failureRecovery: If loading fails after the observed quit, canonical protected-current-host launch is attempted to restore the client; no forced gateway termination is used.
